items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the interviewer mentions Joe Nicholas and compares him to Manuel, but there is no evidence of a personal relationship between the interviewee and Joe Nicholas.

ctx.x: When you were a boy, do you remember the parades you'd followed? Oh yeah. Who played those?
Joe Nicholas, we used to call Wooden Joe. Yeah. Celestan, all like that.
